title: Algebraization of a rational split node over an affine integer finite-type base
statement:
Let $g:Z\to B$ be a flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], locally finitely presented [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with $B$ affine and of finite type over $\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Fix $z\in Z$ with image $b\in B$. Suppose the induced residue-field map $\kappa(b)\to\kappa(z)$ is an isomorphism [def-weil-residue-field], and suppose
$$\widehat{\mathcal O}_{Z_b,z}\cong\kappa(b)[[u,v]]/(uv)$$
as $\kappa(b)$-algebras, where $Z_b$ is the scheme-theoretic fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre], completion is maximal-ideal-adic [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], and power series are [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. Set
$$T=\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[a],\qquad Y=\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[u,v,a]/(uv-a),$$
with $Y\to T$ induced by the inclusion of the parameter $a$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. Then there exist schemes $V,U$, points $v\in V$, $q\in U$, an etale morphism $e:(V,v)\to(B,b)$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], a morphism $\tau:V\to T$, an etale morphism $p:(U,q)\to(Z,z)$, a morphism $w:U\to V$, and an etale $V$-morphism
$$m:U\to Y\times_{T,\tau}V$$
[def-pc-fibre-product], with $e\circ w=g\circ p$, $w(q)=v$, and $\operatorname{pr}_V\circ m=w$. The induced maps $\kappa(b)\to\kappa(v)$ and $\kappa(z)\to\kappa(q)$ are isomorphisms. If $h=\tau^*a\in\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$, the target of $m$ is canonically $\operatorname{Spec}_V(\mathcal O_V[u,v]/(uv-h))$.

source.place: Tag 0CBY, lemma-etale-local-structure-nodal-family, first proof, third paragraph and its concluding application of relative approximation; Tag 0CBX, lemma-formal-local-structure-nodal-family; More on Morphisms Tag 0GDX, lemma-relative-map-approximation-pre; returned parent steps 4--6.

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-lfp-affine-opens-finite-presentation], for all affine opens $U\subseteq Z$, $W\subseteq B$ with $g(U)\subseteq W$ the ring map $\mathcal O_B(W)\to\mathcal O_Z(U)$ is of finite presentation, in particular a finitely generated algebra; hence $g$ is locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] by [lem-weil-pbc-lft-affine-pairs]. By [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian], $B$ is Noetherian. Choose a Noetherian affine neighbourhood of $b$. Its stalk $A=\mathcal O_{B,b}$ is a localization by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-stalk-localization], hence Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-localization-noetherian]. The residue extension has degree one; [lem-trf-finite-residue-point-closed-in-fibre] therefore makes $z$ closed in $Z_b$.

source.place: Tag 0CBY, lemma-etale-local-structure-nodal-family, first proof, split-node paragraph; auxiliary Tags 01T6, 00FN and 01TE

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-formal-local-structure-nodal-family] to $(g,z,b)$. Flatness is given, $A$ is Noetherian by step 1, and its split-node hypotheses are exactly the closedness just proved, the given residue-field isomorphism, and the given completed fibre equation. Its equivalent polynomial-model conclusion gives $H\in\mathfrak m_A\widehat A$, $M_H=\operatorname{Spec}(\widehat A[u,v]/(uv-H))$, its point $o$ with ideal $(\mathfrak m_A\widehat A,u,v)$, and a $\widehat A$-algebra isomorphism $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{Z,z}\cong\widehat{\mathcal O}_{M_H,o}$.

source.place: Tag 0CBX, lemma-formal-local-structure-nodal-family; Tag 0CBY, first proof, third paragraph

proof.text: Define $\sigma_0:\mathbf Z[a]\to\widehat A$ by $a\mapsto H$ and put $\mathfrak t=\sigma_0^{-1}(\mathfrak m_A\widehat A)$, $t=\mathfrak t\in T$. By [lem-weil-pbc-local-completion-local-ring], $\widehat A$ is local with this maximal ideal. Every element outside $\mathfrak t$ maps to a unit, so $\sigma_0$ extends to the local map $\sigma:\mathcal O_{T,t}\to\widehat A$. By [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra], $Y_\sigma$ is $M_H$: the ring isomorphism sends $u\otimes1,v\otimes1,1\otimes c$ to $u,v,c$ and its inverse sends these generators back; the relation is $uv-H$. Take $y_\sigma=o$ and let $y$ be its image in $Y$. This point maps to $t$ and $o$ lies over the closed point of $\operatorname{Spec}\widehat A$. Step 2 supplies the required scalar-compatible completed local isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 0CBY, first proof, construction of sigma and Y_sigma; auxiliary Tags 05GI, 05GG and 01I4

proof.text: Use [lem-trf-relative-completion-etale-approximation] with $X=Z$, $S=B$ and the given $Y\to T$, the points $z,b,y,t$, and the data of step 3. Both bases are of finite type over $\mathbf Z$. The map $Z\to B$ is locally of finite type by step 1; $Y\to T$ is of finite type because its algebra is generated by $u,v$ with one relation. The lemma gives $(V,v)\to(B,b)$, $\tau:V\to T$, $(U,q)\to(Z,z)$ and the etale $V$-map $m:U\to Y\times_{T,\tau}V$. Its commuting diagram gives $e\circ w=g\circ p$, $w(q)=v$, and $\operatorname{pr}_V\circ m=w$, where $w$ is the supplied structure map. The same lemma gives the two residue-field isomorphisms required in the statement.

source.place: Tag 0GDX, lemma-relative-map-approximation-pre, applied as at the end of the first proof of Tag 0CBY

proof.text: Put $h=\tau^*a$. On an affine open $V_0=\operatorname{Spec}C\subset V$, the preimage of $V_0$ in $Y\times_{T,\tau}V$ is $Y\times_{T}V_0$, and $\tau|_{V_0}$ is $\operatorname{Spec}$ of the ring map $\mathbf Z[a]\to C$, $a\mapsto h|_{V_0}$, by [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-into-affine-scheme]; so [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra] identifies the target with the spectrum of $(\mathbf Z[u,v,a]/(uv-a))\otimes_{\mathbf Z[a]}C$. Sending the variables to $u,v,h|_{V_0}$ and constants to constants identifies this algebra with $C[u,v]/(uv-h|_{V_0})$; the inverse fixes $u,v$ and $C$. These maps commute with restriction because they fix the same generators. The affine charts of the relative spectrum in [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-relative-spec](2),(4) therefore identify these spectra canonically with $\operatorname{Spec}_V(\mathcal O_V[u,v]/(uv-h))$.
